in_marathi.name: Lotus
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Symbol of purity and enlightenment
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lotus हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, the lotus is a symbol of creation, enlightenment, and purity. It is believed that Brahma, the creator, was born from the lotus that grew from the navel of Vishnu in the cosmic ocean.
